phase-summary.outcome: Defined the shared spatial contract for future implementation: neutral placement primitives, separate spatial authored docs, per-game overlays for topology semantics, and neutral generated outputs that include both hierarchical graph data and flat placement records.

file.description: Records the shared spatial primitive set, generated output shape, and overlay boundaries.
Phase 58 decisions now capture the neutral primitive model and generated output rules.

decision.summary: Shared spatial data is built from neutral placement primitives, not gameplay-specific classes.
decision.impact: Future codegen and tool integrations can reuse placement logic across multiple games without semantic drift.
